messages:
Alex C: Quick check — I'm running a throughput sweep for continuous batching on the dedicated g4dn pool. Seeing unexpected tail latency when queueing >50ms. Can folks advise best batch_size / max_tokens / max_queue_ms combo? Test command: `./tools/run_throughput.sh --model redwood-large --profile continuous_batching --qps 200 --duration 300`

Priya K: Which quantization and sequence length distribution are you testing with? Also paste the p50/p90/p99 histograms if you have them.

Alex C: Using fp16 (no quant), skewed seq lengths: 80% short (<=64), 20% long (~1024). Quick paste of recent run:```
config: { batch_size: 32, max_tokens: 512, max_queue_ms: 80 }
throughput: 620 tokens/s
p50: 12ms
p90: 38ms
p99: 210ms
errors: 0.2% (queue timeouts)
```

Marco V: That p99 is the issue — looks like long seqs cause big KV cache pressure. Two quick suggestions: reduce batch_size to 16 and lower max_queue_ms to 30ms OR enable size-aware batching that splits by seq length.

Alex C: Good call. I tried batch_size=16 + max_queue_ms=30: throughput dropped to 540 tokens/s but p99 fell to 95ms. No timeouts. Command used: `./tools/run_throughput.sh --config configs/batching/16-30.json`

Priya K: Can you run a regression across seq distributions? We need to ensure short-only workloads don't regress. Use the harness flag `--seq-mix short:0.8,long:0.2` and export `--save-profile <ts>.json` so we can compare.

deploy-bot: Canary completed on pool-g4dn-7. Metrics: GPU util 76%, mem 84%, avg latency +9% vs baseline.

Alex C: Will run the regression sweep. Scheduling three 5m runs now (short-only, mixed, long-only). I'll attach profiles.

Marco V: For the runtime change, I pushed a small prototype to your branch that adds a size-aware batching pass. It uses early_enqueue heuristics and an upper bound on combined tokens per batch. Snippet:
```json
{
  "batcher": "size_aware",
  "max_batch_size": 32,
  "max_combined_tokens": 14000,
  "early_enqueue_ms": 8
}
```

Priya K: Nice. Can we also add a telemetry tag so we can split p99 by batcher type in console? That will help apples-to-apples.

Taylor J: I can review the PR this afternoon (after 4pm PT). Ping me when you add the telemetry flag. :thumbsup:

Alex C: Thanks — I'll run the three sweeps and upload the profiles here. If anyone sees the queue-timeout pattern in older runs, please drop the timestamp.

sre-alert-bot: Note: observed transient spike in host load on pool-g4dn-7 at 1747809300 — correlated with canary. No action required if error rates stay <1%.

Alex C: Uploaded profiles: `1747809201-short.json`, `1747809265-mix.json`, `1747809329-long.json`. Results summary: short-only: throughput 640 t/s p99 45ms; mixed: 540 t/s p99 110ms; long-only: 310 t/s p99 420ms. Will iterate on the size_aware prototype and add telemetry. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
